description.value: BCB Honey Farm is a South Surrey farm store founded in 2003 by Dr. Tabari, who runs thousands of honeybee hives across the Lower Mainland and Peace River to support BC's pollination independence. The farm produces internationally award-winning raw honey — taking First Place at the 2019 International Honey Commission and a Quality Gold Award at the London Honey Quality Competition. Cyclists can stop in at the farm store or pull up to the drive-thru window to pick up locally produced honey and honey infusions.

address.value: 4121 King George Blvd, Surrey, BC V3Z 1G6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and active with recent blog posts (April 2026) confirming the business is open. The farm store at 4121 King George Blvd sells award-winning raw honey (2019 International Honey Commission First Place) and honey infusions, with a drive-thru window option. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; basic groceries is marked true because the store sells food products (honey) purchasable by a passing cyclist.
concerns: OSM lists community as Tsawwassen but the website consistently describes the location as South Surrey; the address (4121 King George Blvd) sits near the municipal boundary.
Two different postal codes appear on the website for the same address: V3Z 1G6 (front page) and V3S 0L2 (our-farm subpage) — postal code should be verified.
OSM has no phone number; phone +1 (604) 722-6867 taken from website only.
Contact page email (info@bcbhoney.com) differs from return-policy email domain (info@bcbhoneyfarm.com) — minor inconsistency on the website itself.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible farm store with a drive-thru option — a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking local honey products along King George Blvd.
